correctness.rationale: Source-form rank-one PowerSGD gives \(C_t=p_tp_t^\top M\), and repeated reuse makes \(p_t\) proportional to \(M(M^\top M)^{t-1}q_0\). On a rank-two SVD this yields an exact rational function of two Gaussian squares. Gaussian rotational invariance reduces expectation to a uniform-angle integral, and the identities for \(\mathbb E[(a\cos^2\theta+\sin^2\theta)^{-1}]\) give the closed form. The actual package replay independently checks both pointwise and integrated formulas.

value.rationale: Warm-start is identified by the PowerSGD source as a key practical mechanism, yet its benefit is otherwise described empirically or asymptotically. The exact rank-two law quantifies that mechanism in the smallest nontrivial model: random initialization carries a condition-number penalty relative to the optimal residual, while one reuse becomes nearly optimal precisely when the spectral gap is large. This gives a reusable calibration benchmark for low-rank compressor initialization and reuse depth.
